question: Who was honoured with the Humanitarian Award at the 72nd Miss World Festival, held in May 2025, for philanthropic work during the Covid pandemic?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonu Sood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonu Sood** was honored with the **Humanitarian Award** at the **72nd Miss World Festival** held in **May 2025** for his exceptional contributions to society during the **Covid-19 pandemic**.
 
• During the pandemic, Sonu Sood emerged as a **real-life hero** by assisting thousands of stranded migrant workers in returning to their hometowns by arranging transportation, including buses, trains, and flights.
 
• He provided **financial assistance** to families who were struggling due to the pandemic and supported students by covering their educational expenses.
 
• Sonu Sood launched a **toll-free helpline** to make it easier for individuals in need to reach out for support. This initiative gained massive appreciation both nationally and internationally.
 
• His philanthropic efforts extended to organizing **oxygen cylinders, hospital beds, and medicines** for Covid-19 patients during the peak of the pandemic.
 
• The recognition at the Miss World Festival highlights the global acknowledgment of his efforts and reflects his role as a **global humanitarian icon**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Sonu Sood:**

 
 
• **Sonu Sood** is an Indian actor, producer, and philanthropist known for his roles in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada cinema.
 
• Born on **30 July 1973**, in **Moga, Punjab**, Sonu Sood transitioned from a successful acting career to becoming a celebrated **humanitarian** during the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
• He was also honored with several awards, including the **SDG Special Humanitarian Action Award** by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
 
 
• **72nd Miss World Festival:**
 
 
• The **Miss World Festival** is an annual international beauty pageant that celebrates talent, culture, and social responsibility.
 
• In its **72nd edition**, held in **May 2025**, individuals and organizations contributing to global welfare were recognized alongside the beauty pageant.
 
 
 
• **Covid-19 Pandemic Impact:**
 
 
• The pandemic, which began in **December 2019**, caused a global health crisis, disrupting livelihoods, healthcare systems, and economies worldwide.
 
• Millions of people, especially **migrant workers**, faced hardships like unemployment, lack of transportation, and access to basic needs during lockdowns.
 
• Philanthropists like Sonu Sood stepped up to provide critical aid during this period, garnering immense respect and admiration globally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Contributions of Sonu Sood:**

 
 
• Sonu Sood's efforts extended beyond India as he helped repatriate Indians stranded abroad in countries like **Kyrgyzstan** and the **Philippines**.
 
• He established the **Sood Charity Foundation**, focusing on healthcare, education, and employment.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees:**
 
 
• **Akshay Kumar:** Known for his donations during crises like the Kerala floods and his contributions to the PM CARES Fund.
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan:** Actively supported Covid relief by providing hospital equipment, transportation, and financial aid to workers.
 
• **Shah Rukh Khan:** Provided financial aid, PPE kits, and other resources during the pandemic through his **Meer Foundation**.
